# Ahmed Wafaey · CV

> Applied AI product leader, Berlin. Senior Director of Product, Growth & AI at Delivery Hero; Co-founder & Chief AI Officer, EBS Dx. English, Arabic, German. Executive MBA, Durham University Business School.

## Applied AI at scale (2022 → now)
- Senior Director of Product, Growth & AI · Quick Commerce, Delivery Hero (Jul 2022 – Present, Berlin, Germany)
  - Lead product, design, analytics, data engineering and product operations for the Growth line of the world's largest quick-commerce business: 7 brands, 4 domains, 17 squads, 75 countries.
  - Grew quick commerce's GMV contribution from 4% to 18% (4.5×) and assortment by 11%.
  - Led Delivery Hero's largest programme: moving the customer experience from store-first to item-first.
  - Established the product operating model for all of Quick Commerce, from problem assessment through launch and learn.
  - Founded the AI practice and guided teams in applying LLMs to content enrichment and discovery.
  - Strengthened the organisation by 24%, adding global product operations, analytics and design.
- Co-founder & Chief AI Officer, EBS Dx (Jan 2026 – Present, Saudi Arabia · Remote)
  - Co-founded an agentic AI executive-education platform for Saudi leaders; lead AI product and architecture.
  - Saria, an AI learning companion, role-based learning paths and a decision Challenge Lab, in Arabic and English.
  - Licensed by TVTC and the National eLearning Center; supported by the Ministry of Investment.
- Founder, ProductVoyagers Labs (Oct 2024 – Present, Berlin · Remote)
  - fustat.ai: AI evaluation of product design against business goals (LLM-as-judge, persona ensembles). 20 customers in its first month.
  - korba.ai: an AI browser where people and agents work side by side; Tauri 2 / Rust, MCP, local-first.
  - Product Voyagers: Substack on product and AI.
- Co-founder, rituals.pm (Mar 2025 – Present, EMEA · Remote)
  - Cohort programmes in English and Arabic where PMs build and launch real AI products (AI PM Builders).
  - Open-sourced pm-os (AI-native PM team OS) and claude-101 (a 25-lesson course inside Claude).

## Consumer platforms at scale (2020 → 2022)
- Product Lead, Internationalization & Personalization, Wayfair (Apr 2021 – Jun 2022, Berlin, Germany)
  - Rebuilt product discovery and localization for international stores, protecting $1.6B in annual gross revenue.
  - Improved localization accuracy by 24% with ML in production.
  - Raised AOV by 8% and cut time-to-market by 48% for teams launching new markets.
- Lead Product Manager, Super App, Careem (Uber) (Jul 2020 – Mar 2021, Berlin, Germany)
  - Launched MENA's first Super App across mobility, delivery and payments, scaling to 48M users.
  - Raised service discovery by 31%; launched the loyalty programme and streamlined partner onboarding.
- Independent Product Advisor & Coach, Breadfast and others (Feb 2020 – Aug 2022, Remote)
  - Advised quick-commerce and grocery startups on growth and product strategy; coached PMs into their next roles.

## Data products (2018 → 2020)
- Senior Strategic Product Manager, Data Analytics Labs, Boeing (Apr 2018 – Jul 2020, Frankfurt, Germany)
  - Turned aviation data into revenue: built a B2B2C data marketplace serving 150+ airline operators.
  - Launched Map-Kit and an analytics suite; reduced cloud costs by 45%.
  - Boeing Star Performer Award, 2018.

## Enterprise systems (2006 → 2018)
- Strategic Product Manager · Customer Solutions Architect · BSS Solution Integrator, Ericsson (Jun 2011 – Mar 2018, Frankfurt, Germany · Egypt)
  - Led the Digital Experience Platform (DXP) launch across 3 telecom operators, integrating CPQ and Customer360; cut operating costs by 35%.
  - Led onsite integration teams putting billing, CRM and order systems into large operators across Europe, the Middle East and Asia.
  - Co-authored Ericsson's DBSS technical certification exams.
- Senior Consultant, Nokia (May 2010 – Jun 2011, Jordan)
  - Led data migration strategy, including customisation and customer-care tools.
- CRM / Billing & Provisioning Lead, Etisalat (Jan 2009 – Jun 2010, Egypt)
  - Owned CRM platform strategy: 360° customer view and unified self-care across channels, integrated with billing and charging.
- Senior Lead Software Engineer, ITWorx (Dec 2006 – Dec 2008, Egypt)
  - Led content-management integrations for clients in the US and the Middle East (Dubai Media Office, du).
